description: Changes an event. Only the fields you pass change. Moving the start date without an end date keeps the length of the event. Passing slug changes the link; the earlier link keeps working until it is disabled with disable_old_link.

accentColor.description: Button color as #rrggbb. Pass null or an empty string to remove it

backgroundColor.description: Page background color as #rrggbb. Pass null or an empty string to remove it

description.description: Description, up to 1000 characters. Pass null or an empty string to remove it

endTime.description: End time as HH:MM, required with a start time. Pass null or an empty string to remove it

event.description: The event: its id, any of its links or the full URL

link.description: Related https link, e.g. tickets. Pass null or an empty string to remove it

location.description: Location, up to 200 characters. Pass null or an empty string to remove it

rsvpEnabled.description: Let guests accept or decline with their name

slug.description: New link, e.g. summer-party for tap2cal.com/summer-party. At least 3 characters, up to 5 new links per event

startTime.description: Start time as HH:MM. Removing it makes the event all-day. Pass null or an empty string to remove it

subtitle.description: Short subtitle, up to 160 characters. Pass null or an empty string to remove it

name: update_event
title: Change a calendar link
